amendments.body: Delete the orphaned file `crates/tank_data/data/source_water/moderate_planted.toml`. It was removed from `SOURCE_WATER_PRESETS` and `source_water_ids()` in `crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs`, and the only scenario that referenced it (`medium_planted.toml`) was switched to `"moderate"`. The file is unreachable through any code path but will confuse future contributors who find it on disk and assume it is loadable.
amendments.rationale: Dead data files that look like active presets create maintenance confusion and could silently re-surface if someone adds it back to the lookup table without understanding it was intentionally retired.

amendments.body: Delete the orphaned test support module `crates/tank_core/tests/support/test_fixtures.rs`. The two test files that imported it (`conservation_regression.rs` via `#[path]` and `e2e_conservation.rs` via `#[path]`) have inlined all fixtures locally. Zero files now reference `test_fixtures`. The `support/` directory can also be removed.
amendments.rationale: The file compiles independently but is never linked into any test binary, so it silently rots. If future fixture changes only update the inlined versions, the orphaned module will diverge and mislead anyone who discovers it.

amendments.body: In `crates/tank_core/src/budget_helpers.rs`, the reformatted diagnostic strings in `assert_budget_balanced` and `assert_per_tick_balanced` dropped the unit label from `in=` and `out=` fields (e.g. `in={:.9} out={:.9}` instead of `in={:.9} mg out={:.9} mg`). Restore the `mg` suffix on in/out fields so the panic message is unambiguous when read in CI logs without surrounding context.
amendments.rationale: Conservation assertion failures are the primary debugging signal for mass-balance regressions. Omitting units from half the reported numbers makes triage harder, especially when the same format is used for nitrogen (mg N), carbon (mg C), and oxygen (mg O2) — the element label only appears once at the top of the message.

payload.summary: Reviewed the tanksim-6e5.4.5 changes across 23 files. The source-water preset upgrades are internally consistent: all GH, KH, DIC, alkalinity, and bicarbonate values are cross-validated and match the documented notes. The pH band tests correctly enforce the expected differentiation (hard_shrimp 7.5-8.0, moderate 7.0-7.5, soft_acidic 6.5-7.0, ro_like 5.5-6.5). The removal of `daily_hourly_photosynthesis_dic_credit_mg` and the dual-DIC-path branching in plant_growth.rs / algae_growth.rs is architecturally coherent with the existing hourly chemistry comments (lines 552-558 of chemistry.rs). The `moderate_planted` preset removal from the lookup table and the `apply_named_scenario_tuning` deletion are clean — the medium_planted scenario now correctly uses "moderate" and starts at 10g total plant biomass matching its notes. Conservation tests compile and their fixtures correctly zero DIC shortcuts for closed-system assertions. Two orphaned files remain on disk and one diagnostic formatting regression was introduced.
